d: Short, choppy dark chestnut brown hair with thick, uneven bangs that partially obscure the eyes. Sharp, narrow golden-yellow eyes with a confident expression on a youthful face with a slender, lean build. Wearing a high-collared black tactical outfit consisting of a button-up shirt, matching slim trousers, and black sneakers with red accents, topped with a black cape featuring white and red detailing. Accessories include a large, glowing yellow circular holographic interface floating behind the shoulder and a massive, futuristic black mechanical sword with a glowing neon blue edge.
